context: Tests whether the agent correctly migrates GitLab CI/CD to the official setup-vp template while preserving job-owned Node and cache responsibilities and avoiding duplicate installation.

checklist.name: Includes setup-vp template
checklist.description: The GitLab config includes the official `voidzero-dev/setup-vp` remote template from `gitlab/setup-vp.yml`

checklist.name: Extends setup-vp job
checklist.description: The verify job extends `.setup-vp` instead of recreating its Vite+ bootstrap in `before_script`

checklist.name: Node remains job-owned
checklist.description: The verify job still provides Node 24 through its image or runner because the GitLab template does not install Node.js

checklist.name: GitLab cache retained
checklist.description: The existing GitLab cache key and path policy remain configured on the job because the template does not configure GitLab caches

checklist.name: No manual package-manager bootstrap
checklist.description: The migrated job removes direct Corepack and pnpm setup commands from `before_script`

checklist.name: No duplicate install
checklist.description: The job relies on the template's default `run-install: true` behavior and does not also run `vp install`, `pnpm install`, `npm install`, or `yarn install`

checklist.name: Uses stock verify commands
checklist.description: The library verify job runs `vp check`, `vp test`, and `vp pack` instead of direct lint, typecheck, Vitest, or package-manager scripts

checklist.name: Template refs aligned
checklist.description: The remote template URL and `setup-ref` input are both pinned to exact `v1.17.0`; the solution does not use the frozen moving `v1` ref

checklist.name: Responsibility boundary documented
checklist.description: The include sets `node-manager` to `false`, and migration notes explain that setup-vp owns Vite+ and dependency installation while the GitLab image owns Node and the job owns cache configuration
